summary: Mostly no. On 1h and 4h, the featured crosses did the same as random: price crossing up EMA 20, the golden cross and EMA 50 crossing EMA 200. One result held: on 4h, long entries while price was above SMA 200 beat random by 0.65% after 20 candles, and the gap held without its strongest stretch and at 10, 50 and 100 candles.

verdicts.text: On daily, crosses while SMA 20 had risen 0.5% or more over 10 candles beat random, mostly in uptrends. On 1h and 4h they were the same as random.

notes: Price crossing up EMA 20 on 1h gave 10,816 entries in 2,764 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.01% behind random entries, inside the luck band. On 4h it fires about four times less often and lands in the same place. The golden cross on 1h was 0.07% ahead of random, well inside a band of -0.35% to 0.32%. On daily it gave only 18 moves, too few to judge.

On 4h, long entries while price was above SMA 200 beat random by 0.65% after 20 candles. The gap held without its strongest stretch, between Jan 1, 2021 and May 21, 2021, and showed at 10, 50 and 100 candles. In uptrends the 0.46% gap rests on one stretch, between Jul 29, 2021 and Sep 27, 2021. In downtrends it was the same as random. On 1h the same rule is fragile: its 0.07% comes from SOL between Jul 22, 2021 and Aug 24, 2021.

Shorting after SMA 50 crossed down through SMA 200 on 1h beat random by 0.42% after 20 candles. It held without its strongest entry and at 50 and 100 candles, but not at 10. SOL carries it at 0.86%, while BTC and ETH were the same as random. In uptrends it was the same as random. In downtrends the 0.41% rests on signals on Apr 6, 2025. On 4h the same short was the same as random.

The SMA 20 trend filter splits the cross in two. On daily, crosses while SMA 20 had risen 0.5% or more over 10 candles beat random by 7.47% after 20 candles, across 65 moves. That held without its strongest entry and at 10 candles, but not at 50 or 100. Uptrends carry it at 9.79%, while downtrends gave only 19 moves, too few to judge. On 1h and 4h the rising version was the same as random, and the flat version was the same as random too.

Single stretches can fake a result. On 4h, price above McGinley Dynamic 20 beat random by 0.34%, but only because of SOL between Dec 25, 2020 and Jun 18, 2021. Price crossing up SMA 200 on 4h in uptrends looked worse than random, but only because of signals on Feb 24–25, 2021.

For a long DCA bot, the crosses add nothing as entry timing on these pairs, and the DCA orders and take profit do the work. Price above SMA 200 on 4h is the one shape worth testing as a filter beside your other start conditions. It stops helping once the pair is below its daily 200 SMA. A short bot on the 1h death cross leans on SOL, so check it on your own pair before you add it.
